affixes.name: Petty
affixes.description: Sera hits harder when they haven't suffered yet.

affixes.name: of Silence
affixes.description: Shut up. x2 damage to anything mid-cast.

affixes.name: Cruel
affixes.description: Kicks them when they're down. +3 below half HP.

affixes.name: of Agony
affixes.description: Every debuff is another reason to hurt.

affixes.name: Moonlit
affixes.description: Touched by moonlight. Grants Divine permission.

affixes.name: of Hemorrhage
affixes.description: Makes them bleed. Then hits harder because they're bleeding.

affixes.name: of Execution
affixes.description: x2 damage below half HP. Finish what you started.

affixes.name: Spectral
affixes.description: Phases through the material. Grants Ethereal permission.

affixes.name: of the First Strike
affixes.description: +5 on the opening hit. Make an entrance.

effects.name: of the First Strike flat bonus

affixes.name: Enfeebling
affixes.description: Saps their will. Their attacks barely register.

affixes.name: of Frost
affixes.description: Freezes them solid. One turn of blessed silence.

affixes.name: of Doom
affixes.description: Marks them for death. When it fades, they pay.

affixes.name: Glacial
affixes.description: Cold focus. Grants Ice and punishes full-health targets.

affixes.name: of Winter
affixes.description: Below half HP, they freeze and break.

affixes.name: Razorwind
affixes.description: Sonic edge. Casting targets take the hint.

affixes.name: Jagged
affixes.description: Every cut opens wider below half.

affixes.name: of the Hunt
affixes.description: Opening hit lands like a verdict.

affixes.name: of Collapse
affixes.description: When doom lands, it lands hard.
